name: A Lesbian Harvest Moon
source:
Fara recently moved into her grandpa's old farm, and becomes suddenly aware of the various attractive women, and their hungry interest in her. 

[From [url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/a-lesbian-harvest-moon]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
法拉最近搬进了爷爷的旧农场，突然意识到各种有魅力的女人，以及她们对她的强烈兴趣。

[来自[url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/a-lesbian-harvest-moon]itch.io[/url]]
